name: myst-dev-kit
description: Team dev kit: 30 skills - engineering/productivity (spec, TDD, triage, debugging, grilling, teaching...) plus the team process rules as on-demand skills (review-and-submit, changelist-verification, pre-implementation-gate...), sync-build-submit + package commands, and the Submit-Audit warning bridge. Reviews run INLINE via the review-changes skill: the two reviewer agents are a Claude-only capability and do not run under Codex. See docs/tool-capability-matrix.md.
